seo.title: LILONGWE - HOMELESS HELP - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified emergency, shelter, food, health, safety, legal and social-support contacts for people facing homelessness in Lilongwe.

page.heading: LILONGWE - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: If someone is in immediate danger, contact the local emergency services listed below. Conflict, weather and local conditions can disrupt services.
page.notice: Information, hours, eligibility and availability can change. Call before travelling when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, treatment or job.
page.intro: Start with the most relevant service below and explain that you are in Lilongwe, whether you have a safe place tonight, and any medical, safety, disability or child-protection needs.
page.footer: Sources are linked in every entry. Services were described conservatively; no accommodation is presented as guaranteed unless the provider publishes it.

entries.title: Malawi Police emergency and victim support
entries.description: Malawi Police emergency and victim support provides or coordinates emergency help in or for Lilongwe. Contact the service directly to confirm eligibility, location and current availability.
entries.how_to_access: Call or use the official website before travelling. Ask specifically what help is available today and whether a referral or documents are required.
